highlights.title: Los nacionalistas de Escocia, Gales e Irlanda del Norte se unen para impulsar su independencia del Reino Unido
highlights.summary: Los líderes firman un manifiesto en el que reclaman a Londres que comience a preparar las reformas constitucionales

highlights.title: Quatro candidatos ao Senado empatam na disputa por duas vagas em SP
highlights.summary: Real Time Big Data mostra Derrite numericamente à frente, com 19%, seguido por Tebet e André do Prado, com 17% cada, e Marina, com 13%

highlights.title: Temporary Hormuz solution deferred as Iran-Arab summit falls through
highlights.summary: Saudi Arabia asked for the meeting to be postponed, but Tehran says it will continue to seek a regionally backed bill.

highlights.title: Was Russian train strike meant to 'scare' the West?
highlights.summary: The EU's top diplomat said Monday that Russian strikes which hit a Warsaw-bound train near Ukraine's border with Poland shortly after top Western figures passed through were meant to "scare" off Kyiv's backers. France 24's correspondent in Kyiv, Gulliver Cragg, has the latest.

highlights.title: Equipes enfrentam ventos e mar turbulento em busca de 129 pessoas após naufrágio na Indonésia
highlights.summary: Centenas de socorristas da Indonésia, incluindo a Guarda Costeira e a Marinha, realizam operações nesta segunda-feira (14) para chegar à balsa de passageiros que naufragou no mar de Java no fim de semana. As equipes procuram 129 pessoas ainda desaparecidas, informaram as autoridades, que confirmaram...

highlights.title: Russia strikes Ukraine with drones as Poland warns of 'escalation'
highlights.summary: Russia continues its ramped-up air campaign against Ukraine, launching 453 drones in an overnight blitz. One drone struck 800 metres from a border crossing with Poland prompting the polish military to scramble fighter jets and helicopters.
